(lambda (g)
  (build-grid (rows g) 3 (r c)
    (let ((left (= 1 (at g r c)))
          (right (= 1 (at g r (+ c 4)))))
      (if (and left right) 2 0))))

(lambda (g)
  (build-grid (rows g) 3 (r c)
    (let ((left (= 1 (at g r c)))
          (right (= 1 (at g r (+ c 4)))))
      (if (or left right) 2 0))))

(lambda (g)
  (build-grid (rows g) 3 (r c)
    (let ((left (= 1 (at g r c)))
          (right (= 1 (at g r (+ c 4)))))
      (if (not (equal? left right)) 2 0))))
